## Personality

Judson Parker is a jovial, smooth-spoken, and sleek individual who often employs suave flattery. Despite his uniformly good-natured and bland demeanor, he is reputed to be quite sharp and generally seen as lacking much principle.

_Sources: [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P42](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0042), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P50](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0050)_

## History

During a Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers) initiative, Judson Parker planned to rent out his fence for painted advertisements, prompting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) to try to talk him out of it. Though he initially refused their requests, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) later accidentally overheard him accepting a political bribe from [Jerry Corcoran](../character/jerry-corcoran.md) near the [Lake of Shining Waters](../codex/places.md#lake-of-shining-waters). Fearing that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) would expose his corruption, Judson agreed to abandon his advertisement plan in exchange for her silence.

_Sources: [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P4](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0004), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P15](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0015), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P35](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0035), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P50](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0050), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P61](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0061), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P65](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0065), +1 more_
